brief:
US Special Envoy Jared Kushner outlined reconstruction goals for Gaza that include full demilitarization, describing the aims as "transparent," according to Middle East Eye. Kushner did not elaborate on how demilitarization would be enforced or what role Palestinian authorities would play in governance.

The statement comes as discussions continue over Gaza's postwar administration and the conditions for its recovery following months of conflict.
dek: Kushner says 'transparent' goals Gaza includes demilitarisation US Special Envoy Jared Kushner says that the goals for Gaza’s reconstruction are "transparent", calling for a "fully demilitarized Gaza".
title: Kushner calls for fully demilitarized Gaza in reconstruction plan
